title: Expand health assistant with full multi-specialty medical knowledge and summarized responses

requirements.text: Expand the specialty knowledge base in `specialtyKnowledgeBase.ts` to include comprehensive, detailed entries for all 10 medical specialties: cardiologists, dermatologists, pediatricians, surgeons, neurologists, general practitioners, anesthesiologists, oncologists, gynecologists, and radiologists. Each specialty entry must include keywords, common conditions, symptoms, diagnostic tools, treatments, red flags, and a formatted content string covering diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.

quotes: cardiologists, dermatologists, pediatricians, surgeons, and neurologists, Major types include general practitioners, anesthesiologists, oncologists, gynecologists, and radiologists. They diagnose, treat, and prevent illnesses across various fields

acceptanceCriteria: All 10 specialties (cardiologist, dermatologist, pediatrician, surgeon, neurologist, general practitioner, anesthesiologist, oncologist, gynecologist, radiologist) have dedicated entries in specialtyKnowledgeBase.ts
Each entry covers diagnosis, treatment, and prevention aspects
Each entry includes at least 10 keywords for routing
Each entry includes red flags / emergency indicators

requirements.text: Expand `medicalKnowledgeBase.ts` to include a broad set of conditions and topics across all 10 specialties — including but not limited to: heart disease, arrhythmia, hypertension (cardiology); acne, eczema, psoriasis, skin cancer (dermatology); childhood illnesses, vaccinations, developmental milestones (pediatrics); pre/post-operative care, wound management (surgery); migraines, epilepsy, stroke, Parkinson's (neurology); common colds, chronic disease management, preventive care (general practice); anesthesia types, pain management, sedation (anesthesiology); cancer types, chemotherapy, immunotherapy (oncology); menstrual disorders, pregnancy, menopause (gynecology); imaging modalities, X-ray, MRI, CT scan interpretation (radiology).

quotes: diagnose, treat, and prevent illnesses across various fields with all issues & problem solving

acceptanceCriteria: medicalKnowledgeBase.ts contains entries for major conditions across all 10 specialties
Each topic entry has relevant keywords and detailed markdown response content
Topics cover diagnosis, treatment options, and preventive measures

requirements.text: Update the assistant routing logic in `assistantBrain.ts` to correctly identify and route user queries to the appropriate specialty handler for all 10 specialties. Ensure the router can handle overlapping symptoms by returning the most relevant specialty match, falling back to general practitioner knowledge when no specific specialty is matched.

quotes: cardiologists, dermatologists, pediatricians, surgeons, and neurologists, Major types include general practitioners, anesthesiologists, oncologists, gynecologists, and radiologists

acceptanceCriteria: Queries mentioning heart, chest pain, arrhythmia route to cardiology
Queries mentioning skin, rash, acne route to dermatology
Queries mentioning child, infant, vaccination route to pediatrics
Queries mentioning surgery, operation, wound route to surgery
Queries mentioning brain, nerve, seizure route to neurology
Queries mentioning cancer, tumor, chemotherapy route to oncology
Queries mentioning anesthesia, sedation, pain management route to anesthesiology
Queries mentioning pregnancy, menstruation, gynecology route to gynecology
Queries mentioning X-ray, MRI, scan, imaging route to radiology
Unmatched queries fall back to general practitioner responses

requirements.text: Update `messageSummarizer.ts` and `responseFormatter.ts` to ensure all assistant responses are presented in a concise, summarized format. Responses must use bullet points and short paragraphs to summarize: (1) likely diagnosis / what the condition is, (2) treatment options, (3) preventive measures, and (4) when to see a doctor. Avoid overly long prose; prioritize scannable, structured summaries.

quotes: all issues & problem solving in summarized matter

acceptanceCriteria: Assistant responses are structured with clear sections: Diagnosis, Treatment, Prevention, When to See a Doctor
Responses use bullet points and/or short paragraphs
Responses are concise and scannable, not long blocks of prose
Medical disclaimer is preserved in the formatted output

requirements.text: Update the Chat page (`Chat.tsx`) and `AssistantPanel.tsx` to display the active specialty context when responding. Show a small specialty badge or label (e.g., '🫀 Cardiology', '🧠 Neurology') above or beside the assistant's response message when a specific specialty knowledge base was used to generate the answer.

quotes: cardiologists, dermatologists, pediatricians, surgeons, and neurologists, Major types include general practitioners, anesthesiologists, oncologists, gynecologists, and radiologists

acceptanceCriteria: A specialty badge/label appears on assistant messages that were generated from specialty knowledge
The badge reflects the correct specialty (e.g., Cardiology for heart-related queries)
General practitioner responses show a 'General Practice' badge
Badge is visually distinct and non-intrusive

requirements.text: Add a specialty selector UI element on the Chat page that allows users to optionally filter or direct their question to a specific medical specialty from the list of 10. When a specialty is selected, the assistant should prioritize that specialty's knowledge base when generating a response. Include an 'Auto-detect' default option.

quotes: cardiologists, dermatologists, pediatricians, surgeons, and neurologists, Major types include general practitioners, anesthesiologists, oncologists, gynecologists, and radiologists

acceptanceCriteria: A specialty dropdown or chip selector is visible on the Chat page
The selector lists all 10 specialties plus an 'Auto-detect' option
Selecting a specialty causes the assistant to use that specialty's knowledge base for the next response
The selected specialty is visually highlighted
'Auto-detect' is the default selection

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/ that are listed as immutable (useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts)
All assistant logic must remain client-side; do not route medical knowledge through the backend
Preserve existing medical disclaimer text in all formatted responses
Do not remove or break existing emergency detection and routing logic in assistantBrain.ts
nonGoals: Real-time AI/LLM integration for medical responses
Backend storage of medical knowledge base content
Actual clinical diagnosis or medical advice (app is informational only)
Integration with external medical APIs or databases
Multi-language expansion of the new specialty content (existing multilingual support is sufficient)

required: Set of 10 medical specialty icon illustrations in a clean, flat style: cardiology heart icon, dermatology skin/magnifier icon, pediatrics child/stethoscope icon, surgery scalpel icon, neurology brain icon, general practice cross/stethoscope icon, anesthesiology mask icon, oncology ribbon/cell icon, gynecology flower icon, radiology X-ray/scan icon (specialty-icons-set.dim_512x512.png)
